purpose: Resolve the seven residual UNKNOWN identity rows from the collision-safe TAFRA/elections.ma 2015 communal-universe join. This file adjudicates identity only. It does not fit coefficients or inspect election outcomes.
principles: No fuzzy similarity alone can create a TRUE.
TRUE requires a distinctive identity bridge supported by party/geography/local-office context.
FALSE requires the complete 2015 universe to contain no compatible identity after homonym/geography review.
The underlying raw and collision-safe ledgers remain immutable; these decisions are an explicit overlay.

decisions.reason: The official PJD pre-election announcement identifies Mohamed Idrissi as the Boulemane head. The complete communal universe contains exact-name homonyms only as MP in Beni-Mellal, PRV in Errachidia and RNI in Khemisset, with no compatible Boulemane/Fes-Meknes identity.

PJD's 2015 presidents-of-communes list names Abd El Halim Allaoui as president of Ouezzane; independent reporting identifies him as president of the municipal council. The spelling difference is a one-letter Arabic orthographic variant.

Hespress identifies MP Mohamed Lachgar as second on the PJD communal list in Ait Amira in the September 2015 communal election. The complete TAFRA universe contains an exact-name PJD elected member in Ait Amira; this resolves the relevant identity despite another same-name PJD row elsewhere in Souss-Massa.

The closed universe contains the distinctive spelling variant Mourad Lakourch as a PJD elected member in Ait Sidi Daoud. Parliamentary and party sources independently tie Mourad Lakourch to Al Haouz and repeated Ait Sidi Daoud local activity, resolving the alias.

The focal Mohamed Lharsh was already PJD provincial secretary in Driouch in 2014. The same-name PJD communal elected record is independently identified in April 2015 as deputy local party secretary in Bouchfaa, Taza, demonstrating a distinct same-name person. Other exact homonyms are in Settat/Taourirt.

The complete 2015 communal universe contains exact-name homonyms only under USFP/PAM in the Oriental region, not a compatible PJD/Rabat-Sale-Kenitra identity. Independent 2021 candidate profiling identifies the focal El Ayadi through his national communications role rather than a 2015 local elected mandate.

The focal Mohamed Marzouk is the PJD Beni-Mellal parliamentary identity elected in 2016. Exact-name 2015 communal records are MDS/Tanant (Azilal) and PAM/Kasbat Ben Mchich (Berrechid); neither matches the focal party/geographic trajectory, and no compatible PJD Beni-Mellal local identity exists in the complete communal universe.
